title: Granular contract regression orchestrator with synthetic anchor tests
creator: Asha Patel
description: Add an orchestrator that runs lightweight, synthetic 'anchor' tests for JSON/structured output contracts whenever a model or serving config change is detected. Anchors are small, deterministic examples that exercise each field/branch in the schema to provide per-field baselines and expected token-level patterns. The orchestrator will compute per-field delta scores, aggregate an overall contract health score, and emit explainable blame candidates (model variant, quantization profile, batcher change, kernel selection). The goal is early, high-precision detection of regressions caused by config/model changes and to provide deterministic anchors for automatic canary gating.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator runs automatically on every model/config rollout and on-demand via API
At least one synthetic anchor per top-level field is stored with a golden response and tokenizer-aligned token map
Per-field delta score produced and exported to metrics (Prometheus) with labels: model, config_hash, field_name, cohort
Blame candidates list returned with confidence score and top 3 likely causes for any detected regressions
Integration tests (CI) that simulate a quantization-induced tokenization drift produce a regression alert and recommended rollback label
implementation_plan: Design anchor schema: small canonical examples + generation rules (edge cases, boundary lengths, nested arrays)
Build Anchor Store: s3-backed artifacts with metadata (model_version, tokenizer_id, canonical_input, golden_output, token_map)
Delta Scorer: implement per-field comparison metrics (exact-match rate, normalized edit distance, token-aligned KL / ngram surprise)
Attribution heuristic: correlate config diffs with delta patterns using weighted feature scoring (quantization, batch size, kernel family, prompt template)
Wire to rollout pipeline: run anchors as pre/post checkpoints during canary and full rollouts; call orchestrator on config-change webhook
Export metrics and traces: Prometheus metrics + OpenTelemetry spans for blame pipeline
UI surface: add a minimal console card for contract health and top blame candidates (Console prototype via PRD)
test_plan: Unit tests for delta scorer functions (edge cases: reordered keys, missing optional fields)
Property tests for token_map alignment across tokenizers and quantized runtimes
Simulated regression fixtures: introduce controlled perturbations (drop field, value truncation, hallucinated type) and assert alerts
Canary end-to-end: deploy model vA -> vB with known regression; verify orchestrator detects regression and annotates rollout with rollback suggestion
Load test: run anchors for a typical customer schema (20 anchors) with no more than 500ms added median latency to a canary run
dashboards: Console: Contract Health overview (time-series of overall score + per-field heatmap)
SRE: Regression incidents list with implicated rollout IDs and blame candidates
Dev: Anchor artifacts browser with diff view and token-aligned highlights
comments: 2026-03-10 Asha Patel: Initial ticket draft. Goal is to make detection precision higher for config-induced regressions; using synthetic anchors to reduce noisy evals.
2026-03-11 Martin Keller: Proposal to store token_map with byte offsets to handle tokenizer upgrades. Will prototype a compact representation for s3 storage.
2026-03-12 Priya Nayar (PM): Suggest adding a regression severity heuristic tied to customer-visible fields. We'll flag address fields and payment fields as higher impact.
2026-03-13 Elena Ruiz (SRE): Need to ensure orchestrator runs under 5s for canary step; otherwise CI rollout time increases. Recommend async background run with immediate quick checks.
2026-03-14 Martin Keller: Chose hybrid approach — lightweight fast anchors for canary path + full anchor battery as async validation. Beginning implementation of Anchor Store interface.
